Introduction

This week, I will try to improve the time metrics per window and in general and also look at trends per state for magnitude and time metrics.

Data loading

Metric functions

source("../metric_functions.R")
source("../graphstat_functions.R")
source("../write_dtw.R")

Saved datasets

hsa_state = read.csv("../hsa_state_inc.csv")
dtw_results = read_csv("../all_dtw_results.csv")
hsa_dtw = dtw_results |>
    left_join(hsa_state, by = join_by(ID == hsa_nci_id))
write_csv(unique(hsa_dtw), "../hsa_vs_state_metrics.csv")
all_metrics = read_csv("../hsa_vs_state_metrics.csv")

Signed lag is backwards

I will rerun the code next week to fix this but for now I will implement something temporary to flip the signs (I did state leads HSA but it should have been HSA leads state).

all_metrics = all_metrics |>
    mutate(signed_lag = -signed_lag)

Window dataset

hsa_unique = hsa_state %>%
    distinct(hsa_nci_id, state)
hsa_list = hsa_unique$hsa_nci_id

res = vector("list", length(hsa_list) * length(windows))
counter = 1

windows = list(w1 = c(1, 50), w2 = c(51, 100), w3 = c(101, Inf))

for (ID in hsa_list) {
    for (w in names(windows)) {

        bounds = windows[[w]]

        out = pivot_wider(dtw_stats(ID, start = bounds[1], end = bounds[2]),
            names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)

        out$ID = ID
        out$window = w

        res[[counter]] = out
        counter = counter + 1
    }
}

dtw_results_window = do.call(rbind, res)
dtw_results_window$window = factor(as.numeric(sub("w", "", dtw_results_window$window)),
    levels = c(1, 2, 3))
dtw_results_window = dtw_results_window %>%
    rename(peak_window = window)
dtw_results_window$peak_window = as.numeric(dtw_results_window$peak_window)

glimpse(dtw_results_window)

Ground truth

all_metrics_modified = all_metrics |>
  mutate(week_index = (epi_week + (epi_year - 2022) * 52 - 38),
    peak_window = case_when(
      week_index <= 50  ~ 1,
      week_index <= 100 ~ 2,
      TRUE              ~ 3
  ))

peak_centroid = function(x, weeks, q = 0.80) {
  threshold = quantile(x, q, na.rm = TRUE)
  mask = x >= threshold & !is.na(x)
  if (sum(mask) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(weeks[mask], x[mask])
}

truth_peaks =
  all_metrics_modified |>
  group_by(ID, state, peak_window) |>
  summarise(
    # HSA peak
    hsa_peak_week     = week_index[which.max(inc_hsa)],
    hsa_peak_value    = max(inc_hsa, na.rm = TRUE),
    hsa_centroid      = peak_centroid(inc_hsa, week_index),

    # State peak
    state_peak_week   = week_index[which.max(inc_state)],
    state_peak_value  = max(inc_state, na.rm = TRUE),
    state_centroid    = peak_centroid(inc_state, week_index),

    # Argmax differences (keep for comparison)
    truth_time_diff     = hsa_peak_week - state_peak_week,
    truth_time_diff_abs = abs(truth_time_diff),

    # Centroid difference (new)
    centroid_time_diff     = hsa_centroid - state_centroid,
    centroid_time_diff_abs = abs(centroid_time_diff),

    truth_mag_ratio = hsa_peak_value / state_peak_value,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

Time

diff_peak_time = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(!is.na(centroid_time_diff) & !is.na(signed_lag))
timing_cor_table = diff_peak_time |>
    group_by(peak_window) |>
    summarise(cor_mean_abs_lag = cor(truth_time_diff_abs, mean_abs_lag,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_signed_lag = cor(truth_time_diff,
        signed_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_median_lag = cor(truth_time_diff,
        median_lag, use = "complete.obs"), cor_lag_sd = cor(truth_time_diff,
        lag_sd, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")
print(timing_cor_table)

print(timing_cor_table2)

centroid_lm = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_time)
summary(centroid_lm)

plot(centroid_lm)

diff_peak_time$pred = predict(centroid_lm, newdata = diff_peak_time)

    fill = as.factor(peak_window))) + geom_point(pch = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_line(color = "firebrick", aes(y = pred), lwd = 1.2) +
    theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~peak_window) + labs(x = "DTW signed lag",
    y = "True timing difference (centroid)", title = "Predicted vs. true peak timing difference") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

diff_peak_time_zoom = diff_peak_time |>
    filter(signed_lag >= -10, signed_lag <= 10, centroid_time_diff >=
        -10, centroid_time_diff <= 10)

centroid_lm_zoom = lm(centroid_time_diff ~ signed_lag * factor(peak_window),
    data = diff_peak_time_zoom)

timing_cor_table2 |>

        title = "DTW timing metric correlations by window")

Magnitude

diff_peak_mag = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)  #, dtw_rmse < 5)
ggplot(diff_peak_mag, aes(x = frechet, y = truth_mag_ratio, fill = as.factor(peak_window))) +

US map visualization

us_map = readRDS("../us_map_pop_sf.rds")

lower48 <- setdiff(c(state.name, "District of Columbia"), c("Alaska",
    "Hawaii"))

diff_peak_map = diff_peak_data |>
    filter(signed_lag >= -10, signed_lag <= 10, centroid_time_diff >=
        -10, centroid_time_diff <= 10) |>
    filter(state_peak_value > 0, hsa_peak_value > 0, frechet <
        25, truth_mag_ratio < 5)

# compute per-HSA correlations
hsa_cors = diff_peak_map |>
    group_by(ID, state) |>
    summarise(cor_timing = cor(signed_lag, centroid_time_diff,
        use = "complete.obs"), cor_mag = cor(frechet, truth_mag_ratio,
        use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop")

hsa_cors = hsa_cors |>
    mutate(composite = cor_timing + cor_mag)

us_map_plain = us_map |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::select(-geometry_hsa) |>
    filter(state %in% lower48)

us_map_cors = us_map |>
    filter(hsa_nci_id %in% us_map_plain$hsa_nci_id) |>
    left_join(hsa_cors |>
        rename(hsa_nci_id = ID), by = c("hsa_nci_id", "state"))

# map 1: timing correlation (signed_lag vs
# centroid_time_diff)
timing_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_timing), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "white",
        name = "Correlation", limits = c(-1, 1)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Timing: signed lag vs. centroid time diff")

# map 2: magnitude correlation (frechet vs truth_mag_ratio)
mag_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = cor_mag), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "white",
        name = "Correlation", limits = c(-1, 1)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Magnitude: Frechet vs. truth mag ratio")

# added together map
composite_map = ggplot() + geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
    "geometry_hsa"), aes(fill = composite), color = "gray20") +
    geom_sf(data = sf::st_set_geometry(sf::st_as_sf(us_map_cors),
        "geometry"), fill = NA, color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "white",
        name = "Composite", limits = c(-2, 2)) + coord_sf() +
    theme_void() + labs(title = "Composite correlation (timing + magnitude)")
timing_map/mag_map/composite_map

Conclusion

I got timing metrics to work this time by looking at the correlation of the top 20% of magnitudes (instead of one week peaks) and then using that to see how the signed lag would correlate (DTW lag seems to correlate with truth lag) with centroids of the top 20%. Okay, and they seem to have pretty good correlation which holds even after removing outliers. I then plotted three US maps, one for the lag vs centroid diff correlation, the next for frechet vs mag_ratio correlation, and the last US map as a sum to see which HSAs are consistently agreeing with metrics in both time and magnitude. Next week, I might look at R^2 per window and if there are any variables that explain the composite HSA scores in the map above.
